title: Russo-Turkish War (1828–1829)
summary:
The English Wikipedia article "Russo-Turkish War (1828–1829)", at revision 1371356411, opens: "The Russo-Turkish War of 1828–1829 resulted from the Greek War of Independence of 1821–1829; war broke out after the Ottoman Sultan Mahmud II closed the Dardanelles to Russian ships and in November 1827 revoked the 1826 Akkerman Convention
in retaliation for the participation of the Imperial Russian Navy in the Battle of Navarino of October 1827." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q287942, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1828–1829 part of the Russo-Turkish wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
